While it isn't a surgical solution, this balm does an incredible job of deeply hydrating dry under-eye areas all day. It works seamlessly under makeup and provides long-lasting moisture, making it ideal for daily dry skin care.

I love using this as an additional step at night time or any time my skin needs a pick me up, instant glow and soothing in my opinion. Unsure about how effective it is fid wrinkles/collagen loss, but I primarily purchased this as an introductory anti-aging product as I am only in my mid 20s.

avis.titre: This product is amazing!!! Moisturizing amd smooth
avis.texte: Smooth and Moisturizing effect on my skin. flawless look ! Almost "filter " effect! Don't need much foundation. Will buy again at ULTA;trustworthy source for genuine authenticity.

This isn't an instant fix. Korean skincare is about gentle, nourishing, long-term care so you can't expect fast Western skincare results. So the next time you see a Korean product go viral on TikTok or IG, keep in mind that they are trying to sell you something and that it may take 6 weeks or more to see the actual results - and not every viral product is designed for your particular skin. Your skin might not like some of the ingredients - that's not the product's fault.
I add this to my undereyes after I wash my face! It always makes the bags under my eyes look so much smoother and preps them for makeup!

avis.titre: Great balm! Wonderful if you have realistic expectations!
avis.texte: I personally really like this balm so far! I've been using it for around a month now, and I am seeing an improvement in the firmness of my under eye skin, and my smile lines aren't as bad as they used to be. Obviously it hasn't helped with my hollow under eyes, it's not filler and cannot be expected to have results like that, but for a topical product it's doing great, and this is coming from someone with sensitive skin and hEDS.
Expensive! I've been using it consistently and now changes at all. Save your money

Hi, skincare expert here! This stick is essentially all wax and next to zero active ingredients. The calcium and collagen they claim will tighten and firm? Less than 2% concentration. If you are looking for a stick that will give hydration, then this is an alright choice. Any plumping or smoothing you are seeing in your skin is purely due to better hydration, and nothing else.

I LOVE this entire calcium line. I can see a difference in my under eyes already and been using for like a week. I use the calcium eye patches, calcium serum day and night and then this balm at night. It smooths, depuffs, lines are reduced. I also see less darkness under my eyes. I recommend
